title: Herbalife CFO to Participate in Fireside Chat at Bank of America Leveraged Finance Conference on December 1

# Herbalife CFO to Participate in Fireside Chat at Bank of America Leveraged Finance Conference on December 1


[Download as PDF](https://d1io3yog0oux5.cloudfront.net/_e1b6c8a8da72ce1c42133ce4e8852ac4/herbalife/news/2026-11-20_Herbalife_CFO_to_Participate_in_Fireside_Chat_at_963.pdf) Nov 20, 2026 • 7:05 am ET


LOS ANGELES--(BUSINESS WIRE)-- Herbalife Ltd. (NYSE: HLF), a premier health and wellness company, community and platform, today announced Scott Schaefer, Chief Financial Officer, will participate in a fireside chat at the BofA Securities Leveraged Finance Conference in Boca Raton, FL on Tuesday, December 1, 2026 at 7:30 a.m. ET (4:30 a.m. PT).


The live webcast will be available at the following link:[https://kvgo.com/2026-leveraged-finance-conference/herbalife-ltd-december](https://nam10.safelinks.protection.outlook.com/?url=https%3A%2F%2Fkvgo.com%2F2026-leveraged-finance-conference%2Fherbalife-ltd-december&data=05%7C02%7Csamanthagou%40herbalife.com%7C5b6d8a94915d4892766508df463cd826%7C101f87a76d6b4c6c9d9c223592a2ba50%7C0%7C0%7C639306899297714498%7CUnknown%7CTWFpbGZsb3d8eyJFbXB0eU1hcGkiOnRydWUsIlYiOiIwLjAuMDAwMCIsIlAiOiJXaW4zMiIsIkFOIjoiTWFpbCIsIldUIjoyfQ%3D%3D%7C0%7C%7C%7C&sdata=4HHis1eiGmAn8Pm4mrfPfayxCzIUKfvK9ay8ENH5JNc%3D&reserved=0)


A link to the webcast will also be available under the Investor Relations section of Herbalife's website at[https://ir.herbalife.com/](https://ir.herbalife.com/) . A replay of the webcast will be available at the same website following the completion of the event and for six months thereafter.


**About Herbalife Ltd.**


Herbalife (NYSE: HLF) is a premier health and wellness company, community and platform that has been changing people's lives with great nutrition products and a business opportunity for its independent distributors since 1980. The Company offers science-backed products to consumers in more than 90 markets through entrepreneurial distributors who provide one-on-one coaching and a supportive community that inspires their customers to embrace a healthier, more active lifestyle to live their best life.


For more information, visit[https://ir.herbalife.com](https://ir.herbalife.com/) .
